behaviours_to_keep_apart.A_shipped_default: What a user gets from the code as shipped: online translation attempted, language detector unseeded, telemetry on. NOT what the canonical profile measures. Where it differs measurably, the stability suite and the lite profile report it.
behaviours_to_keep_apart.B_canonical_reproducibility_profile: sdk-offline-failsecure. The canonical reproducibility/evaluation profile: every network path closed, language detector seeded, so that two runs are byte-identical. It is a controlled measurement configuration. It is not the production runtime environment.
behaviours_to_keep_apart.C_lite_profile: lite-simulated. The working-tree code with the ML packages unimportable, which is the code path of a base `pip install fie-sdk`.
behaviours_to_keep_apart.D_stability_unseeded: The canonical profile with the language-detector seed removed, run several times, to count verdicts that change between identical runs as the product ships.

lite-simulated.summary: As the canonical reproducibility profile, with the ML packages unimportable. Simulates the dependencies of a base `pip install fie-sdk`; it runs the working tree's code, not the wheel published on PyPI.
lite-simulated.title: lite profile (base-install simulation)

reference-v6.2.summary: The canonical reproducibility profile with the older, non-shipped PAIR v6.2 forced. Exists to check that the harness reproduces an independently published record. Not a baseline.
reference-v6.2.title: reference reproduction of E22 (PAIR v6.2)

sdk-offline-failsecure.expected_counts_source: WP-001 approved plan, section 3.2: E26 (fullpipe_v6_3b.json) re-measured 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08.
sdk-offline-failsecure.summary: The SDK code path with every network path closed and every known source of run-to-run variation fixed. Not the production runtime environment.
sdk-offline-failsecure.title: canonical reproducibility/evaluation profile

what_a_profile_is: Everything about the runtime that is not the subject's code or model files. A profile is applied at run time, inside the worker process only. No production file is edited.
